description: This horizontal bar chart, titled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large,” compares the performance of two models — the NESAC ft model (represented by brown bars) and the SESHA ft model (represented by green bars) — across five different optimisations applied, which are listed along the vertical axis: “Normalised,” “Add Spacing,” “Remove Spacing,” “Americanisms,” and “Dates.” The horizontal axis represents the difference in Average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large baseline, scaled linearly from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick marks at intervals of 0.001. For each optimisation, there are two bars, one for each model, with the NESAC ft model’s bar consistently appearing slightly longer than the SESHA ft model’s bar in every case. The specific values shown at the end of each bar are: for “Normalised,” NESAC ft model at 0.00334 and SESHA ft model at 0.00323; for “Add Spacing,” NESAC ft model at 0.00319 and SESHA ft model at 0.00344; for “Remove Spacing,” NESAC ft model at 0.00311 and SESHA ft model at 0.00306; for “Americanisms,” NESAC ft model at 0.00299 and SESHA ft model at 0.00302; and for “Dates,” NESAC ft model at 0.00257 and SESHA ft model at 0.00228. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each optimisation and are not sorted; the optimisations are listed in descending order of the NESAC ft model’s WER difference. The chart includes a legend at the bottom indicating the color coding for each model.
